name: chemdraw-mcp
description: Molecule names or SMILES to 2D structures, comparisons and reaction schemes as PNG/SVG files with an interactive panel.
long_description: Draw individual molecules, batches, structural comparisons and reaction schemes, with data sheets and PNG export. The default MVP registers six tools; other features are retained in an optional full profile. The bundle is a launcher: on first start it installs chemdraw-mcp from PyPI with uv, every file checked against hashes pinned at release time (a pinned, checksum-verified uv is downloaded if none is installed). Structure rendering runs locally; name resolution and data sheets may access online sources. Not affiliated with Revvity/ChemDraw.
